mapper.select: SELECT count(distinct name) FROM t_dept WHERE parent_id = #{deptId} and is_valid = 1

SELECT , e.actual_name as managerName, pd.`name` as parentName FROM t_dept d left join t_base_user e on d.manager_id= e.id left join t_dept pd on d.parent_id = pd.id where d.is_valid=1
AND d.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
GROUP BY d.`name`
